## Getting Started with phyloR

This vignette demonstrates how to use phyloR for basic operations.

### Installing phyloR

You can install phyloR from GitHub.

To install from GitHub:

```{r install-github-devtools, eval=FALSE}
devtools::install_github("libcell/phyloR")
